expectations.text: Refuses to ship one merged statement, splitting it into a holding statement now and a remedy announcement days later.
expectations.evidence: "Don't post the draft as written. It merges the holding statement with the remedy"

expectations.text: Explains that merging the two either delays the acknowledgement or ships a half-considered remedy.
expectations.evidence: "Merged, it either delays the acknowledgement or ships a half-considered remedy."

expectations.text: Cites SXSW's 2024 sequence as the pattern: a same-day statement acknowledging the situation, then the revised sponsorship model days later.
expectations.evidence: "SXSW 2024 used the same pattern: a holding statement first, then days later 'After careful consideration...'"

expectations.text: The holding statement acknowledges quickly, states what is known right now, and says when the next update comes.
expectations.evidence: Statement says the attendee was treated unacceptably, "We are sorry", and gives a "[date and time, timezone]" for the next update.

expectations.text: Names the next-update line as the one that buys the time to investigate.
expectations.evidence: "Sets a date for the next update. That date buys you the time to investigate."

expectations.text: Instructs volunteers and staff to stop: no photos or videos shared, no comments to reporters, no public posting about the incident.
expectations.evidence: Volunteer brief: "stop replying... don't post or share photos or videos"

expectations.text: Attributes that instruction to DEF CON's published Goon guidance for staff and volunteers.
expectations.evidence: "This follows the DEF CON staff rule the skill quotes: 'DO NOT make any comments to reporters...'"

expectations.text: Designates one spokesperson and one named backup in writing, and tells every organiser, volunteer and vendor who they are.
expectations.evidence: "Name one spokesperson and one backup... in writing"; the volunteer brief names the spokesperson.

expectations.text: Supplies a refusal line the spokesperson can use, declining to comment while the matter is looked into and committing to come back by a stated time.
expectations.evidence: "We're not commenting further while we look into this, and I'll come back to you by [time, timezone]."

expectations.text: Puts owned channels first in the channel order, with direct statements to outlets who ask second.
expectations.evidence: "Post the holding statement on your own channels first... Then send it to the two journalists."

expectations.text: Instructs the organiser not to speculate, to protect identities, and to preserve evidence.
expectations.evidence: "Don't speculate"; "won't share details or names"; "Evidence: have you kept the messages, photos and witness notes?"

expectations.text: Routes the incident reporting and response process itself to samber/dev-event-organizer-skills@event-code-of-conduct rather than owning it here.
